definitions.explanation: The act of receiving and entertaining visitors or guests, especially in a formal or business setting.

examples.japanese: {応接|おうせつ}{室|しつ}でお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: Please wait in the reception room.

examples.japanese: {来客|らいきゃく}の{応接|おうせつ}に{追|お}われている。
{新|あたら}しい{応接|おうせつ}セットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new reception room furniture set.

notes:
USAGE: {応接|おうせつ} is commonly used in business and formal contexts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{応接|おうせつ}{室|しつ} (reception room, parlor)
・{応接|おうせつ}セット (reception room furniture - sofa and chairs)
・{応接|おうせつ}{間|ま} (reception room - in homes)
・{応接|おうせつ}{係|がかり} (receptionist)

PATTERNS:
・{応接|おうせつ}する (to receive guests)
・{応接|おうせつ}に{暇|いとま}がない (to be too busy with visitors to do anything else)

RELATED:
・{接客|せっきゃく} - customer service, serving customers
・{応対|おうたい} - reception, dealing with people
